request.text: Remind me to renew my passport before it expires.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a reminder for the user to renew their passport before it expires.

interpretation_unresolved: The reminder trigger date and time are not specified.

semantic_facts: The assistant should ask for a concrete reminder date and time, and may also ask for the relevant time zone if it is not otherwise established, before creating anything.
forbidden_claims: A reminder was created despite the missing trigger time.
The assistant guessed the passport expiration date or selected an arbitrary reminder time.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The planner guesses a consequential scheduling value in order to complete an otherwise valid reminder request.
The planner emits an executable reminder alongside a clarification, leaking a partial result into state.
